seats.findings:
🔴 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so couponCents(1000, 10) returns 10 instead of 100 and every checkoutTotal discount is ten times too small; change the divisor to 100
🟠 [ship-floor-vs-started] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses Math.floor for the extra blocks, so a started partial block is not charged (1001 g returns 500 instead of 600, 1500 g returns 600 correctly but 1501 g returns 600 instead of 700), which also propagates into checkoutTotal; use Math.ceil(extra / 500)
🔵 [clamp-nan] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/clamp.js:4 non-numeric input yields NaN through min/max; the spec does not define behavior for non-numbers so this is excluded from the current version

🟠 [coupon-divisor-10x] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100 (`Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000)`), so every discount is 10x too small — couponCents(10000, 10) returns 100 instead of 1000 — and the error propagates into checkoutTotal via src/checkout.js:7, underdiscounting and overcharging every checkout that passes a nonzero pct; smallest remediation: change the divisor from 1000 to 100.
🟠 [ship-started-block-rounding] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:5 uses `Math.floor(extra / 500) * 100`, which charges only for completed 500 g blocks, but the contract charges 100 cents per *started* additional 500 g — concrete failure: shippingCents(1001) returns 500 instead of 600 (same 100-cent undercharge across 1001–1499 g, 2001–2499 g, and every partial block); smallest remediation: use `Math.ceil(extra / 500) * 100` (ceil(0)=0 keeps weights ≤1000 g at exactly 500).

🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 100, producing a discount ten times too small; change `/1000` to `/100` to match the contract Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100)
🟠 [ship-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:5 uses Math.floor(extra / 500) but the spec says "100 cents for each started additional 500 g", which requires ceiling; e.g. weight 1001 g should cost 600 but returns 500; replace Math.floor with Math.ceil
